items.a: Self-storage is your own lockable space in a shared facility. You choose a unit, bring your belongings and organise them yourself. Unlike collection-and-delivery storage, you can visit your unit directly.

items.q: How do I choose a size?
items.a: Make a list of your items and measure the largest pieces. Use our size guide as a starting point, then confirm dimensions and access space with the team. Packing style and stacking affect what fits.

items.q: Can I access my belongings anytime?
items.a: StoreLah offers 24/7 self-access after your booking and access are activated. Use your assigned PIN for facility entry and follow your unit access instructions.

items.q: Do I pay a security deposit or admin fee?
items.a: No security deposit or admin fee. Your quotation will separately show rental, mandatory protection and any optional services you select.

items.q: Is protection included in the advertised rental?
items.a: Starting rental figures do not include the mandatory Protection Plan unless your quotation explicitly says so. Review the coverage, premium, exclusions and total monthly cost before booking.
Standard monthly storage has no long-term lock-in. If you choose a promotional commitment plan, a minimum stay and early-exit conditions may apply. Confirm those terms before agreeing.

Once the facility is open, you can book and move in on the same day. Complete the booking requirements and payment to receive your access code. Pre-opening reservations begin from the confirmed opening and start date.

Most clean, dry household belongings, furniture, documents, equipment and permitted business stock are suitable. Do not store perishables, hazardous materials, illegal items or living things. Ask about anything you are unsure of.

items.q: Can someone else access my unit?
items.a: Only share access through the method permitted by your agreement. Ask the team about authorised users if a family member, colleague or mover will visit.

items.q: Can I view a unit first?
items.a: Once open, self-guided viewings can be arranged outside office hours. Verify your identity on arrival and follow the approved viewing access instructions. Pre-opening requests will be confirmed when visits become available.
Rental is billed monthly under your storage agreement. Your quotation should show billing dates, any initial part-month charges and the payment options available.

items.q: Can I run my business from a unit?
items.a: Units are for storing belongings and permitted stock. Office use, retail activity, fulfilment services and delivery acceptance are not included by default. Confirm permitted use before booking.
Follow the notice period in your agreement, clear your unit and complete the required move-out checks. Ask the team about the process before your planned departure.
Sembawang is taking reservations ahead of opening. Woodlands and Ubi are also coming soon. Your move-in or viewing begins only from the confirmed opening and booking date.

seo.description: Privacy, plainly. How this site handles an enquiry you choose to send.

props.heading: Privacy, plainly.
paragraphs: How this site handles an enquiry you choose to send.

blocks.text: Your enquiry stays in your hands.
The contact and viewing forms prepare an email draft. They do not submit your enquiry to a website database. Information is sent to StoreLah only when you send that email.
What you share
Your request can include your name, email address, preferred date, storage needs and message. Share only the information needed for the enquiry.
Why you share it
The information helps the team respond about availability, a quote or a viewing. Contact hello@storelah.sg about access, correction or deletion of enquiry information.
Website resources
This website loads fonts from Google Fonts. Your email application and linked services have their own privacy policies.
A complete company privacy policy, data protection contact and retention details should be confirmed before adding online booking or further data collection.
